Archival Dispatch: 11 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Classic Radio Themes and AFRS Basic Music Library

Batch 23 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 23 resolves 11 historical master recordings: 7 original network signature theme song transcription discs (including the iconic Signal Oil eerie whistling introduction from The Whistler, Orson Welles' Ceiling Unlimited for Lockheed, and Nick Carter, Master Detective), alongside 4 rare vinyl transcription discs from the Armed Forces Radio Service Basic Music Library (featuring Sam Cooke live at the Copacabana and Boyd Raeburn's progressive jazz orchestra).

1. Classic Radio Opening Themes — Network Master Discs Dated

Original network signature openings and orchestral intros:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Signature Theme Subject
Theme_The_Whistler_9530.mp3 "The Whistler: Original Signal Oil Opening Theme" 1942-05-16 The haunting 13-note whistle and footsteps opening for West Coast CBS listeners.
Theme_Behind_The_Mike_1231.mp3 "Behind the Mike: Opening Theme & Monologue" 1940-10-06 NBC's behind-the-scenes radio documentary signature theme.
Theme_Nick_Carter_6832.mp3 "Nick Carter, Master Detective: Opening Theme" 1943-04-11 Mutual Network's dramatic foghorn and organ theme.
Theme_Radio_City_Playhouse_7515.mp3 "Radio City Playhouse: NBC Opening Theme" 1948-07-03 NBC Studio 8H symphonic dramatic overture.
Theme_Nona_From_Nowhere_6877.mp3 "Nona from Nowhere: Bab-O Opening Theme" 1950-01-09 CBS daytime serial opening theme and sponsor billboard.
Theme_Ceiling_Unlimited_2115.mp3 "Ceiling Unlimited: Orson Welles Lockheed Opening Theme" 1942-11-09 Orson Welles' stirring aviation theme for Lockheed-Vega aircraft workers.
Theme_Joe_Garagiola_5253.mp3 "Joe Garagiola's Sports Show: Lang Field Opening" 1958-03-15 Major League Baseball spring training radio introduction from Florida.

2. AFRS Basic Music Library — Armed Forces Master Discs

Transcriptions pressed on 16-inch vinylite for overseas military radio stations:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Musical Repertoire
Basic_Music_Library_Sam_Cooke_Copa.mp3 "AFRS Basic Music Library P-9115: Sam Cooke at the Copacabana" 1964-07-08 Sam Cooke live at the Copacabana club performing The Best Things in Life Are Free.
Basic_Music_Library_Boyd_Meets_Stravinsky.mp3 "AFRS Basic Music Library: Boyd Raeburn Orchestra ('Boyd Meets Stravinsky')" 1946-03-15 Groundbreaking progressive big band orchestration arranged by George Handy.
Basic_Music_Library_Victor_Borge_Kern.mp3 "AFRS Basic Music Library: Victor Borge ('Jerome Kern Medley')" 1945-12-10 Danish piano virtuoso Victor Borge performing Jerome Kern compositions.
Basic_Music_Library_Cal_Shrum_Old_Shep.mp3 "AFRS Basic Music Library: Cal Shrum and His Rhythm Rangers ('Old Shep')" 1944-08-20 Western swing and country ballad recorded for GI shortwave broadcast.
